plan.title: Three-way split award with no approval

steps.note: Open the existing closed RFQ with the prepared bids on Master QCS.
Enable split awarding as required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the awarding screen for the prepared event.
Allocate 4 units to the second prepared bidder, the closest available equivalent to vendor B.
Allocate the remaining 6 units to the first prepared bidder so the available two-vendor split covers all 10 units.
Verify both available vendors are selected and the closest achievable split totals 4 × 90 plus 6 × 100 = 960.
